chapter: Young players, Coltrane and the avant-garde
title: The Freedom School and Coltrane letting players on stage
summary: They discuss how Coltrane let weak players come up and tell their stories.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Right. See,and,and that Freedom School, see --
